_purpose: Purpose: all worker-extension-authored messages and audit explanations. Audience: operators, context reviewers, and the worker if Pi surfaces an error. Injection: use individual values only; never inject this header or the entire file.

flags.context: Absolute path to the parent-generated .gho/input/context.json for this worker run.

errors.invalid_resources: Worker resources are invalid. Review agent-context/tool-definitions.json and agent-context/strings.json before retrying.
errors.invalid_context: Worker context is invalid. Expected schema 1, run_id, issue URL/title/body, base_commit, branch, explicit context_files, and a nonempty expected_bootstrap.
errors.invalid_context_path: The --gho-context flag must name the current worktree's .gho/input/context.json using an absolute path. Symlinks are not allowed for the context directories or file.
errors.invalid_worktree: The worker's tool directory and session directory do not match the recorded worktree.
errors.missing_bootstrap: The effective system prompt is missing the expected Isara bootstrap. No model request is permitted.
errors.missing_context_file: The effective system prompt does not contain every explicit context file's path and unmodified content. No model request is permitted.
errors.ambient_context: Unexpected discovered context files, skills, or a forced system-prompt replacement are present. No model request is permitted.
errors.unexpected_tools: The selected tools or their schemas differ from the seven reviewed worker tool definitions. No model request is permitted.
errors.context_io: The worker could not read its context or save effective-context.json. No model request is permitted. Check file permissions and retry through the orchestrator.
errors.audit_failed: Worker context verification failed. No model request is permitted.

audit.purpose: Purpose: pre-request worker context evidence. Audience: operators and reviewers. Injection: this file is an audit artifact, not an additional prompt. It is writable by the worker process and is not a cryptographic attestation.
assumptions: The parent launches a fresh JSON-mode Pi process in this worktree, with explicit system, append, task, provider, worker, and session paths. Inputs live under .gho/input; effective-context.json is written outside that read-only input directory.
Discovery is disabled for extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, and context files; project trust is declined and built-in tools are disabled.

The worker is the last prompt-observing extension; the only other explicit extension is the reviewed Isara provider. Later extension mutations are outside this snapshot contract. The parent supplies an isolated Pi home through its sandbox shim.
Explicit repository safety guidance is preserved in the system prompt. Isara's mandatory bootstrap remains present and can instruct the worker to read repository files.
Repository files, issue text, command output, and tool results can introduce further context. Resource isolation is not a filesystem sandbox or protection against prompt injection.
Tool execution, runtime results/errors, Pi protocol framing, and provider request conversion come from pinned Pi and the Isara provider, not agent-context.
The snapshot records the before_agent_start boundary, not every later provider request, compaction, or runtime tool result.
